methodology.variance: Sample variance with denominator n - 1; unavailable when n < 2.
methodology.quantiles: Linear interpolation at p05, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90, and p95.
methodology.mode: Exact repeated finite values only; all-unique samples report no mode instead of imposing an arbitrary histogram binning rule.
methodology.median_absolute_deviation: Median of absolute deviations from the sample median; no consistency scaling.
methodology.coefficient_of_variation: Sample standard deviation divided by the absolute mean; unavailable at a numerically zero mean.
methodology.skewness: Bias-corrected Fisher-Pearson sample skewness; unavailable when n < 3 or variance is zero.
methodology.excess_kurtosis: Unbiased Fisher excess kurtosis; unavailable when n < 4 or variance is zero.
methodology.outliers: Observed values below Q1 - 1.5*IQR or above Q3 + 1.5*IQR.
methodology.histogram: Freedman-Diaconis bin width when IQR is positive, otherwise Sturges' rule; bin count is limited to 20.
methodology.claim_pooling: Claim statistics pool finite observations. Documents with more observations therefore contribute more; document_mean_statistics separately describes the distribution of per-document means.
